name: Weekly short-form video publish (illustrative example, not run by this repo)

reviewer.name: content owner
reviewer.mechanism: signs off against every artifact below before the publish gate opens

spending_limit.description: example only: cap editing/narration time and stock-asset spend per episode; anything over the cap is escalated for approval before work continues

inputs: raw and licensed footage and audio
outputs: published video on the target channel
asset manifest: what was used and under what license

gates.name: script
requires: written script approved by the content owner

gates.name: visual-plan
requires: shot list or storyboard matching the approved script

gates.name: asset-receipts
requires: a receipt or license record for every externally sourced asset used

gates.name: audio-check
requires: loudness and clarity pass on narration and music

gates.name: final-review
requires: content owner sign-off against the script, visual plan, asset receipts, and audio check
